info.title: Knowledge Base API
info.description:
The Knowledge Base API provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to the TOPdesk Knowledge Base.

This version of the API can be used after the migration to the folder structure has been completed. If you are not using the folder structure in the knowledge base yet, please use the [API for before the explorer migration](https://developers.topdesk.com/explorer/?page=knowledge-base&version=knowledge-base-before-migration) instead.

[Read the guide to help you with the transition.](https://my.topdesk.com/tas/public/ssp/content/detail/knowledgeitem?unid=95c50b8eb96c4e709ef1d98006ac3cae)

get.summary: Returns a list of Knowledge Items.
get.description: Returns a list of Knowledge Items, satisfying a given `query`. When called without any parameters, this endpoint will return the first 100 Knowledge Items, sorted by the Knowledge Item number, smallest first. Only the Knowledge Items which have content in the requested language will be listed. It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then branch filters do not apply.

post.summary: Creates a Knowledge Item with given content
post.description: Creates a Knowledge Item with given content. The `parent` is mandatory and must reference a Folder. It is necessary to have the permission to create Knowledge Items. In order for an operator / operator group to be assigned as manager, the "Knowledge Base Manager" task must be selected in the Supporting Files module.

get.summary: Returns the Knowledge Item by id or number.
get.description: Returns the Knowledge Item with the given identifier. By default, this endpoint will only return the Knowledge Item which has content in the requested language. It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then branch filters do not apply.

patch.summary: Updates properties of the Knowledge Item.
patch.description: Updates the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier`. Using this endpoint, `visibility`,`status`, `manager`, and `externalLink` can be updated.Changes that affect the visibility for operators / users in linked branches take up to 5 minutes to become effective.In order for an operator / operator group to be assigned as manager, the "Knowledge Base Manager"task must be selected in the Supporting Files module.It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items. To unset `status`, `manager` or `externalLink`, declare the field as `null` in the request. For example: `"status": null` Any field that is not present in the request will not be changed. ⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update the properties of an archived knowledge item. ⚠️**Note**: It is no longer possible to set the parent of a knowledge item through this method. Please use the dedicated /move endpoint for this purpose. ⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first. ⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to change the `sspVisibilityFilteredOnBranches` and `operatorVisibilityFilteredOnBranches` without 'read' permission for Branches.

post.summary: Archives the Knowledge Item.
post.description: Archives the Knowledge Item with the given identifier. If the Knowledge Item is already archived nothing will change. It is necessary to have the permission to update and archive Knowledge Items.

post.summary: Unarchives the Knowledge Item.
post.description: Unarchives the Knowledge Item with the given identifier. The Knowledge Item can only be unarchived if the parent folder is not archived. If the Knowledge Item is already unarchived nothing will change. It is necessary to have the permission to update and archive Knowledge Items.

post.summary: Creates a new translation for the Knowledge Item.
post.description:
Creates a new translation for the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier` in the specified `language`. The language must be in TOPdesk's language list. It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to create a translation for an archived Knowledge Item.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

patch.summary: Updates a translation of the Knowledge Item.
patch.description:
Updates the translation of the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier` in the specified `language`. Only the fields, which are included in the request, will be updated. Other fields remain unchanged. The language must be in TOPdesk's language list. It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

⚠️**Note:** It is not possible to update the translation of an archived Knowledge Item. 

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

delete.summary: Delete a translation of the Knowledge Item.
delete.description:
Delete the translation of the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier` in the specified `language`. The operation is successful if the translation was deleted or if the Knowledge Item or the translation does not exist. The translation can only be deleted if it is not the last remaining one. It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to delete a translation for an archived Knowledge Item.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

post.summary: Moves the Knowledge Item under a different parent Folder.
post.description:
Moves the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier` to the specified parent Folder. It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

⚠️**Note**: The moved Knowledge Item will inherit the visibility settings of its new parent Folder.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to move an archived Knowledge Item. Please unarchive it first.

get.summary: Returns all linked branches of the Knowledge Item.
get.description: Returns all linked branches of the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier`. It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items and the permission to read branches. Because of the needed permission to update knowledge items, the branch filters do not apply on the individual knowledge item level, however the returned branches from this endpoint are still limited to the ones visible to the operator.

post.summary: Links a branch to the Knowledge Item.
post.description:
Links the specified branch to the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier`. Only branches that are visible to the operator can be linked. Note that it takes up to 5 minutes for the change to become effective.It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items and the permission to read branches.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to link a branch to an archived Knowledge Item.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

post.summary: Unlinks a branch from the Knowledge Item.
post.description:
Unlinks the specified branch from the Knowledge Item with the given `identifier`. Only branches that are visible to the operator can be unlinked. Note that it takes up to 5 minutes for the change to become effective. It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items and the permission to read branches.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to unlink a branch from an archived Knowledge Item.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

post.summary: Adds feedback to the given Knowledge Item
post.description: Adds feedback for the given Knowledge Item.

get.summary: Lists images uploaded under given Knowledge Item.
get.description: Used to list all images that have been uploaded under given Knowledge Item. The list may contain images that were uploaded but not actually used as inline images inside the Knowledge Item. It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then branch filters will not apply.

post.summary: Uploads an image to the Knowledge Item.
post.description:
Uploads an image to an existing Knowledge Item with the given identifier. In order to upload an image the update permission on Knowledge Items is necessary. Therefore, branch filters will not apply. It is not possible to upload an image to an archived Knowledge Item and the allowed image formats are jpg, png, bmp and gif.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

get.summary: Downloads an image from the Knowledge Item.
get.description: Downloads an image with a given name from the Knowledge item with the given identifier. It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then branch filters will not apply.

delete.summary: Deletes an image from the Knowledge Item.
delete.description:
Deletes an image with the given name from the Knowledge Item with the given identifier. It is only possible to delete images from Knowledge Items that are not archived. In order to delete images, the permissions to update a Knowledge Item are necessary. Therefore, branch filters will not apply.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

get.summary: Lists attachments uploaded to given Knowledge Item.
get.description: Used to list all attachments that have been uploaded to the given Knowledge Item. It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then branch filters will not apply.

post.summary: Uploads an attachment to a Knowledge Item.
post.description:
Uploads an attachment to an existing Knowledge Item with the given identifier. In order to upload an attachment the permission to update a Knowledge Item is necessary. Therefore, branch filters will not apply. It is not possible to upload an attachment to an archived Knowledge Item.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

get.summary: Downloads an attachment from a Knowledge Item.
get.description: Downloads an attachment with a given attachment identifier from a Knowledge Item with the given identifier. It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then branch filters will not apply. The returned content type depends on the file type with a default of 'application/octet-stream' if the file type could not be detected.

delete.summary: Deletes an attachment from a Knowledge Item.
delete.description:
Deletes an attachment with the given attachment identifier from a Knowledge Item with the given identifier. It is only possible to delete attachments from Knowledge Items that are not archived. In order to delete an attachment, the permissions to update a Knowledge Item are necessary. Therefore, branch filters will not apply. 

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update any knowledge items that live in the root of the explorer (which means they do not have a parent). Should these knowledge items exist, please use the `/move` endpoint to move them to a folder first.

get.description:
Returns a list of Folders, satisfying a given `query`. When called without any parameters, this endpoint
will return the first 100 Folders, sorted by the Folder number, smallest first. Only the Folders
which have content in the requested language will be listed.
It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then
branch filters do not apply.

⚠️**Note**: When a language is specified, this will only affect the fields related to the translation of the folder (e.g. title, description and the translation creator/modifier fields). If none of these fields are added to the request, the language parameter is ignored.

post.summary: Creates a Folder with given content
post.description:
Creates a Folder with given content. Optionally, if the `parent` is provided, the new Folder will be a child of this Folder. Otherwise, it will be created on the top level.
It is necessary to have the permission to create Knowledge Items.
In order for an operator / operator group to be assigned as manager, the "Knowledge Base Manager" task must be selected in the Supporting Files module.

get.summary: Returns the Folder by id or number.
get.description:
Returns the Folder with the given identifier. By default, this endpoint will only return the Folder which has content in the requested language.
It is necessary to have the permission to read Knowledge Items. If additionally the permission to update Knowledge Items is present, then branch filters do not apply.

patch.description:
Updates the Folder with the given `identifier`. Using this endpoint, `visibility`, `manager` and `externalLink` can be updated.
Changes that affect the visibility for operators / users in linked branches take up to 5 minutes to become effective.
In order for an operator / operator group to be assigned as manager, the "Knowledge Base Manager"
task must be selected in the Supporting Files module.
It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

To unset `manager` or `externalLink`, declare the field as `null` in the request. For example: `"manager": null`

Any field that is not present in the request will not be changed.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update the properties of an archived folder. 

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to change the `sspVisibilityFilteredOnBranches` and `operatorVisibilityFilteredOnBranches` without 'read' permission for Branches.

post.summary: Archives the Folder.
post.description: Archives the Folder with the given identifier and all its children and further descendents. If the Folder is already archived nothing will change. It is necessary to have the permission to update and archive Knowledge Items.

post.summary: Unarchives the Folder.
post.description: Unarchives the Folder with the given identifier and all its children and further descendents. The Folder can only be unarchived if the parent item is not archived. If the Folder is already unarchived nothing will change. It is necessary to have the permission to update and archive Knowledge Items.

post.summary: Creates a new translation for the Folder.
post.description:
Creates a new translation for the Folder with the given `identifier` in the specified `language`. The language must be in TOPdesk's language list. It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to create a translation for an archived Folder.

patch.summary: Updates a translation of the Folder.
patch.description:
Updates the translation of the Folder with the given `identifier` in the specified `language`.
Only the fields, which are included in the request, will be updated. Other fields remain unchanged.
The language must be in TOPdesk's language list.
It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to update the translation of an archived Folder.

delete.summary: Delete a translation of the Folder.
delete.description:
Delete the translation of the Folder with the given `identifier` in the specified `language`.
The operation is successful if the translation was deleted or if the Folder or the translation does not exist.
The translation can only be deleted if it is not the last remaining one.
It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to delete a translation of an archived Folder.

post.summary: Moves the Folder under a different parent Folder.
post.description:
Moves the Folder with the given `identifier` to the specified parent Folder.
It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items.

get.summary: Returns all linked branches of the Folder.
get.description:
Returns all linked branches of the Folder with the given `identifier`.
It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items and the permission to read branches. Because of the needed permission to update Knowledge Items, the branch filters do not apply on the individual folder level, however the returned branches from this endpoint are still limited to the ones visible to the operator.

post.summary: Links a branch to the Folder.
post.description:
Links the specified branch to the Folder with the given `identifier`. Only branches that are visible to the operator can be linked.
Note that it takes up to 5 minutes for the change to become effective.
It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items and the permission to read branches.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to link a branch to an archived Folder.

post.summary: Unlinks a branch from the Folder.
post.description:
Unlinks the specified branch from the Folder with the given `identifier`. Only branches that are visible to the operator can be unlinked.
Note that it takes up to 5 minutes for the change to become effective.
It is necessary to have the permission to update Knowledge Items and the permission to read branches.

⚠️**Note**: It is not possible to unlink a branch from an archived Folder.

get.summary: Returns if the explorer is migrated
get.description:
Returns if the explorer is migrated or not.
This endpoint can be used until 31st of December 2026 to determine which API to use.

It is required to have read permissions on knowledge items.

get.summary: Returns the reference of the folder created from the knowledge identifier
get.description:
Returns the identifier and number of the folder created during the Explorer Migration from the provided knowledge item. This only gives results for knowledge items that used to be a parent item in the old explorer.
If a knowledge item has been deleted, you will not be able to find the folder using the knowledge item number. In this case, we did maintain the connection via the identifier, so you can use the knowledge item identifier for look-up instead.

This endpoint can be used until 31st of December 2026 to help with updating the original structure (Knowledge Items) to the new structure (Folders).

It is required to have read permissions on knowledge items, but branch filters do not apply.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The id or name of the knowledge item for which the folder is requested

identifier.name: identifier
identifier.description: ID or the number of a Knowledge Item.

number.summary: Identifier supplied as an item number. The number should include spaces and the abbreviation (like KI)

folderIdentifier.name: identifier
folderIdentifier.description: ID or the number of a Folder.

number.summary: Identifier supplied as an item number. The number should include the prefix (like FOLD-)

language.name: language
language.description: The language of the Knowledge Item content, in BCP 47 format.

fields.name: fields
fields.description:
This parameter allows the client to specify which fields of Knowledge Items are present in responses. `ID` and `number`
fields are always included in Knowledge Item. It's possible to request additional fields of Knowlege Items, by supplying
a comma separated list of field names in `fields` parameter.
Note that, unknown or repeating items in the `fields` parameter will result in an error. Also, a field that does not have a value
is never returned, even if it is explicitly requested using this parameter.
Valid field names for Knowledge Items are listed below:
* parent
* visibility - will include all values from the KnowledgeItemVisibility schema
* urls - will include three urls which point to this KI via operator, ssp and public (provided that the Public Knowledge Base feature is enabled in the settings)
* news
* manager
* status
* standardSolution
* externalLink
* language
* title
* description
* content
* commentsForOperators
* keywords
* creator
* modifier
* creationDate
* modificationDate
* translation.creator
* translation.modifier
* translation.creationDate
* translation.modificationDate
* availableTranslations

folder_fields.name: fields
folder_fields.description:
This parameter allows the client to specify which fields of Folders are present in responses. `ID` and `number`
fields are always included in Folder. It's possible to request additional fields of Folders, by supplying
a comma separated list of field names in `fields` parameter.
Note that, unknown or repeating items in the `fields` parameter will result in an error. Also, a field that does not have a value
is never returned, even if it is explicitly requested using this parameter.
Valid field names for Folders are listed below:
* parent
* visibility
* manager
* externalLink
* language
* title
* description
* creator
* modifier
* creationDate
* modificationDate
* translation.creator
* translation.modifier
* translation.creationDate
* translation.modificationDate
* availableTranslations

language_query.name: language
language_query.description:
The language of the Knowledge Item content, in standard BCP 47 format. If not specified, defaults to the
 TOPdesk default language. If a Knowledge Item is not translated to this language, it will not be included
in the results.

folder_language_query.name: language
folder_language_query.description:
The language of the Folder content, in standard BCP 47 format. If not specified, defaults to the
 TOPdesk default language. If a Folder is not translated to this language, it will not be included
in the results.

start.name: start
start.description: The offset at which to start.

page_size.name: page_size
page_size.description: The maximum amount of results to return. Must be between 1 and 1000.

query.name: query
query.description: An FIQL query to filter the response. The fields available for filtering are: * parent.id * parent.name * visibility.sspVisibility * visibility.sspVisibleFrom * visibility.sspVisibleUntil * visibility.sspVisibilityFilteredOnBranches * visibility.operatorVisibilityFilteredOnBranches * visibility.publicKnowledgeItem * visibility.branches.id * visibility.branches.name * manager.id * manager.name * status.id * status.name * standardSolution.id * standardSolution.name * creator * creationDate * modifier * modificationDate * externalLink.id * externalLink.type * externalLink.date * archived * news

folder_query.name: query
folder_query.description: An FIQL query to filter the response. The fields available for filtering are: * parent.id * parent.name * visibility.sspVisibility * visibility.sspVisibleFrom * visibility.sspVisibleUntil * visibility.sspVisibilityFilteredOnBranches * visibility.operatorVisibilityFilteredOnBranches * visibility.publicKnowledgeItem * visibility.branches.id * visibility.branches.name * manager.id * manager.name * externalLink.id * externalLink.type * externalLink.date * archived

size.description: The size of the attachment in bytes.

uploadedBy.description: The id of the operator that uploaded the attachment.

CreateKnowledgeItemParams.description: Translation and parent folder are mandatory when creating a new Knowledge Item.

CreateKnowledgeItemTranslation.description:
Represents a translation of a Knowledge Item, with the translated content.
When creating a translation, `title` is a mandatory field.

description.description:
The description of the Knowledge Item. The maximum text length (excluding tags) is 50000 characters.
The following html tags can be used to format the text:
  * italic \<i\> or \<em\>
  * bold: \<b\> or \<strong\>
  * underline: \<u\>
  * link: \<a\>
  * line break: \<br\>
  * \<p\> and \<div\> tags are left as they are, but a line break (same as with \<br\>) is added afterwards

Note: HTML entities can be used to encode characters that are reserved in HTML, e.g., use \< instead of <.

content.description:
The content of the Knowledge Item. The maximum text length (excluding tags) is 50000 characters.
The following html tags can be used to format the text:
  * italic \<i\> or \<em\>
  * bold: \<b\> or \<strong\>
  * underline: \<u\>
  * link: \<a\>
  * images: \<img\> (When creating or updating Knowledge Items, images must have been uploaded to the Knowledge Item with the help of the corresponding endpoint. The images are uniquely identified by their name and the image height and width have to be given (in pixel).)
  * line break: \<br\>
  * \<p\> and \<div\> tags are left as they are, but a line break (same as with \<br\>) is added afterwards

Note: HTML entities can be used to encode characters that are reserved in HTML, e.g., use \< instead of <.
content.example:
bold
italic
underline
Link to TOPdesk

commentsForOperators.description:
The comments for operators accessing this Knowledge Item. The maximum text length (excluding tags) is 50000 characters.
The following html tags can be used to format the text:
  * italic \<i\> or \<em\>
  * bold: \<b\> or \<strong\>
  * underline: \<u\>
  * link: \<a\>
  * images: \<img\> (When creating or updating Knowledge Items, images must have been uploaded to the Knowledge Item with the help of the corresponding endpoint. The images are uniquely identified by their name and the image height and width have to be given (in pixel).)
  * line break: \<br\>
  * \<p\> and \<div\> tags are left as they are, but a line break (same as with \<br\>) is added afterwards

Note: HTML entities can be used to encode characters that are reserved in HTML, e.g., use \< instead of <.
commentsForOperators.example:
bold
italic
underline
Link to TOPdesk

keywords.description: List of tags/keywords used for search. The list is represented as a single string (whitespace or comma separated).

errorCode.description: A consistent error code that can be used to recognize types of errors programatically

appliesTo.description: The property this error applies to

errorMessage.description: A human-readable description of the error

id.description:
The id of the entity in the external system
Size range: `maximum 450 characters`.

type.description:
The type of the link
Range: `A non-zero integer formatted as string`. Each integration should use its own value. If multiple integrations use the same value, records could be shared between the integrations.

questionAnswered.description: Field indicating whether the knowledge item is useful according to the user

feedbackText.description: Feedback written by the user for this knowledge item
feedbackText.example: Thank you for the clear explanation written in this article.

When creating a Folder, `language` and `title` (in `content`) are mandatory fields.

modifier.description: Read-only. ID and name of the operator, which updated this translation most recently.

modificationDate.description: Read-only. The last update date and time of the translation. Provided in ISO-8601 format and always in UTC.

news.description: True, if this item is a News Item.

creator.description: ID and name of the operator which created this Knowledge Item.

creationDate.description: The creation date and time. Provided in ISO-8601 format and always in UTC.

modificationDate.description: The last update date and time of the Knowledge Item. Provided in ISO-8601 format and always in UTC.

availableTranslations.description: A list containing a language code for each translation of the Knowledge Item, provided in BCP 47 format.

The following html tags can be used to format the text:
  * italic \<i\> or \<em\>
  * bold: \<b\> or \<strong\>
  * underline: \<u\>
  * link: \<a\>
  * images: \<img\> (When creating or updating Knowledge Items, images must have been uploaded to the Knowledge Item with the help of the corresponding endpoint. The images are uniquely identified by their name and the image height and width have to be given (in pixel).)
  * line break: \<br\>
  * \<p\> and \<div\> tags are left as they are, but a line break (same as with \<br\>) is added afterwards

Note: HTML entities can be used to encode characters that are reserved in HTML, e.g., use \< instead of <.
content.example:
bold
italic
underline
Link to TOPdesk

keywords.description: List of tags/keywords used for search. The list is represented as a single string (whitespace or comma separated).

prev.description: A link to the previous page of Knowledge Items

next.description: A link to the next page of Knowledge Items

KnowledgeItemTranslation.description:
Represents a translation of a Knowledge Item, consisting of a language code and the translated content in that language.
When creating a Knowledge Item, `language` and `title` (in `content`) are mandatory fields.

creator.description: Read-only. ID and name of the operator which created this translation.

creationDate.description: Read-only. The creation date and time. Provided in ISO-8601 format and always in UTC.

modifier.description: Read-only. ID and name of the operator, which updated this translation most recently.

modificationDate.description: Read-only. The last update date and time of the translation. Provided in ISO-8601 format and always in UTC.

KnowledgeItemUrls.description:
The URLs where the given Knowledge Item is directly accessible. These URLs are generated by TOPdesk for viewing in a browser.
All URLs are generated and returned; however, depending on the Knowledge Item's visibility, they may not all be reachable.
URLs will be relative to the http root (i.e. starting with a '/')

operator.description: This is the URL for operators; an operator login is required to view this page.

ssp.description:
This is the URL for Self-Service-Portal users, a login to Self Service Portal is required to view this page.
It is only reachable if the Knowledge Item's Visibility is set so that it is currently visible in the SSP.

public.description:
This is the URL for public access (if this feature is enabled), no login is required to see this page. This link will provide you with the knowledge item in the default
language. To view it in another language, replace the last part of the url (i.e. "/en/") with the language code of your choice.
Only present if the Public Knowledge Base feature is enabled in the settings and the knowledge item is published.

sspVisibleFrom.description:
The date and time when the item is first visible in SSP. Should be provided in ISO-8601 format. The return
values are always in UTC. This field is only set or required when `sspVisibility` is set to VISIBLE_IN_PERIOD.

sspVisibleUntil.description:
The date and time when the item is visible until in SSP. Should be provided in ISO-8601 format. The return
values are always in UTC. This field is only set or required when `sspVisibility` is set to VISIBLE_IN_PERIOD.

publicKnowledgeItem.description: Read-only. True, if the item is a Public Knowledge Item (provided that the Public Knowledge Base feature is enabled in the settings).
